## Summary

The bounded change and the problem it solves.

## Evidence and behavior

What was observed before the change, what changed, and what evidence supports the result. Keep executed, observed, and narrated state separate where relevant. Disclose AI assistance here if any (tool and level of involvement).

## Verification

Every command actually run and its observed result.

```text
command:
result:
```

## Limits

Unverified claims, instrumentation limits, compatibility boundaries, or follow-up work. Write `None observed` only if that is accurate.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request has one bounded purpose and excludes unrelated changes.
- [ ] Every reported test result was actually observed in this revision.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private transcript, personal data, or private machine path is included.
- [ ] Unknown or unverified states remain explicit.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff and followed the Code of Conduct and CONTRIBUTING guide.
